user.description: Connect to your restic REST server (https://github.com/restic/rest-server).

data_description.url: The restic-rest-server's own address, including the repository path, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8000/myrepo
data_description.username: HTTP Basic Auth username for the rest-server, if it requires one
data_description.password: HTTP Basic Auth password for the rest-server, if it requires one
data_description.repo_password: The restic repository's encryption password. Unrelated to the server username/password above.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the restic repository with these settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one restic location can be configured.
abort.addon_not_installed: The Restic Restserver Backup add-on is not installed. Install it from the Add-on Store, start it, and try again.
abort.addon_not_running: The Restic Restserver Backup add-on is not running. Start it and try again.
abort.addon_unavailable: Could not ask the Supervisor about the Restic Restserver Backup add-on. Check the Home Assistant log.
